question: Which golden-hall dancer who imparts verbal instruction grants protection?
premises: A dancer in the golden hall is the subject.
This dancer is engaged in giving verbal instruction.
The dancer is asked to grant protection.
inference: The golden-hall dancer who teaches verbal instruction is invoked as protector.
uncertainties: The precise sense of 'ānunvaśāsanaṃ' as verbal or grammatical instruction is contextually inferred.
plain_english: May the dancer of the golden hall, who gives instruction in words, protect us.
